newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to be mostly steady to weaker on Tuesday, weighed down by sluggish nearby demand and ample supply, dealers said.
Feed manufacturers are slow in doing anything due to a slowdown in demand, a Buffalo dealer said. "So we do not see much happening until tomorrow (Wednesday)," he added.
In the Southeast, the harvest of the soft red winter wheat was beginning to get underway and may cut into millfeed demand.
The SRW harvest in both North and South Carolina will lose a few buyers. "We are seeing some people buying wheat instead of millfeeds," a North Carolina dealer said.

Other dealers said they believe the market had a negative undertone. "I believe we will drift lower," a Tennessee dealer said. "The west is quiet and dropping. We had the holiday weekend and these downtimes are behind us now. Flour mills are expected to run a bit better but demand was a bit weaker. The combination of the two is going to drive the market down."
